story.vex: Blur your zones together and I'll walk straight through. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: every system now sits in its correct zone, and nothing crosses straight from public to restricted. Astro: "One boundary at a time. No shortcuts."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Read zone-drill.txt: five Citadel systems with no zone assigned. Classify each as public, dmz, or restricted.

1. type zone-drill.txt
2. classify <system> public | dmz | restricted
files.C:\\Citadel\\zone-drill.txt:
ZONE DRILL
-----------
system-public-beacon    broadcasts the Citadel's callsign to any passing ship — open to everyone
system-comms-relay      talks to allied fleets outward, and passes verified requests inward
system-starmap-vault    the crew's most sensitive data, never talks to the outside directly
system-guest-terminal   a kiosk visiting allies use, filtered on both sides
system-command-core     Astro's private command systems, reached only through the relay

steps.title: Volt's Drill: read the system list
steps.body: Volt: "Read every system before you place a single one." `type zone-drill.txt`.

steps.title: Place each system in its zone
steps.body: Volt: "Open to everyone is public. Filtered both ways is dmz. Sensitive and reached only through the dmz is restricted." Classify all five systems.
